sections.text:
[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 7XL.
Increases physical and magic attack Ability success value by M+.
Increases damage when using a physical or magic attack Ability by M.
Applies Pulverize, which permits piercing through invulnerability and damage nullification effects when attacking.
Ability Power scales with the number of Fire elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of 7XL+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
M+
Activation rate scales with the number of Fire elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).
